_README: Optional. For each portfolio image, add an entry keyed by its filename. 'alt' improves accessibility + SEO (screen readers, Google Images). 'objectPosition' nudges the crop focus (e.g. 'center 20%' shifts the visible area up). Any image without an entry still works with a sensible default. After adding photos or editing this file, run: npm run portfolio
